family_reports.body: Life has never been the same. The injustice is heavy
It is psychologically messing up my children.
Being a low income single black mother in Oklahoma is apparently cause to be deemed unfit.

public_comments.comment_text: Filed aggressively false DHS report against me. She was sued twice in 2022 by others. Allegations include misrepresenting professional credentials and qualifications; presenting opinions beyond the scope of licensure or expertise; failing to maintain professional records; ethical obligation concerns; exceeding the appropriate role of a treating therapist in family court matters; providing information or opinions that influenced custody and psych evaluations; making reports or recommendations alleged to be false or misleading. In my own case, I experienced many of the same, and am connected with an additional mother who did as well. Cancelled several appointments at the last minute to attend other emergency court hearings. Allowed associate to provide court ordered anger management to the father while she provided therapy to the kids so they could work together and share notes. Graduated him despite documentation of continued harassment and concerning behaviors. Years lost that could have been dedicated to kids healing instead of additional trauma. My experience left serious concerns about this pattern of practice when working with traumatized children. Update according to public data: appears to be relying on the Oklahoma Citizens Participation Act, which protects first amendment rights, and is requesting victim to pay all legal fees.
